comments.body:
This recipe (Making Female Nobel Treasure Crown) is available from Irene in the Marseille tavern. Sewing R10 required. Ingredients:

Georgette Fabric x10
Goldwork x10
Jewellery x10

Stats:
Jewellry Trading +1
8k fame to equip; female-only and color-customizable

Cheers.
